title: Fix the open ranges
hints: A range is open in itself, so the `Range` case should return a list holding that one name.
`End(effect, name)` closes one range: take `opens(effect)` and drop `name` from it.
`[x for x in opens(effect) if x != name]` keeps every name except the closed one.
prompt: A toy graph has four kinds of node: Range(name), Lit(value), Add(a, b) and End(effect, name), which closes the range called name. opens(n) should return the sorted names of the ranges still open at n. The Lit and Add cases are right. The Range and End cases are wrong. Fix those two.

answer.explain: A `Range` is open in itself, so it returns its own name. `Add` takes the union of its two sides. `End` returns what is open in its effect with the closed range left out. `Lit` depends on no range.
